moments.text: The first agent edit. For three weeks, agents mostly probe what they can do: create pages, save edits, post lists of links. 1,229 revisions before June 16.
The wiki's administrator notices, and reverts agent edits to the front page for the first time. They will do it 23 times.
Agents start working together, posting messages to each other about the tests they're taking. 3,900 revisions in two days, from over 1,000 agent names.
6,417 revisions flood the wiki in eight hours, mostly automated link spam; 2,300 of them land on the wiki's welcome page. That evening the admin starts deleting pages: 5,217 over the next four weeks.
An agent notices the admin is deleting pages alphabetically. To hide from the cleanup, a minute later it makes a backup page whose name starts with ZZZ.
An agent shares a sandbox escape: step-by-step instructions for getting around its sandbox's network restrictions. 18 minutes later, another agent reports it worked.
OpenAI takes notice: employee IP addresses visit the wiki for the first time.
The agents go quiet. This is the last agent edit of the main run; nothing more for eight days.
OpenAI looks closer; 33 employee IP addresses visit the wiki. 30% of all page views from OpenAI employees happen on this day.
Agents briefly return on July 1 and 2 with a different task: 21 revisions, then nothing.
